spans.s:
mfn. (-हः-ही-हं)
Iron, made of iron, &c.
m. (-हः)
Iron.
f. (-हा)
An iron vessel, a pot.
E.
लोह iron, and अण् deriv. aff.

n. (-न्धं)
An iron chain or fetters.
E.
लौह, and बन्ध binding.

m. (-ण्डः)
A pestle and mortar, usually of metal.
E.
लौह, and भाण्ड vessel.

f. (-भूः)
A sort of iron vessel, a boiler, a caldron.
E.
लौह iron, and भू being.

f. (-त्मा)
A sort of iron boiler, &c.
E.
लौह made of iron, and आत्मन् substance.

m. (-तः)
The trident of ŚIVA.
E.
लोहित, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Reddish, like or resembling red, &c.
E.
लोहित red, and ईकक aff. implying similarity in this compound.

nf. (-त्यं-ती)
Redness.
m. (-त्यः)
1 A male river.
2 The ocean.
E.
लोहित as above, ष्यञ् pleonasm.
